pick.name: Neon Free
pick.what: Serverless Postgres with branching and scale-to-zero
pick.why: Most generous commercial-OK free Postgres for many small products: 100 projects, no inactivity deletion, branch-per-PR
pick.free_limits: 100 projects; 100 CU-h/project/mo; 1 GB/project (20 GB total); 5 GB egress/project; 10 branches; 6 h history (no instant restore); suspends after 5 min idle; Launch $0.106/CU-h + $0.35/GB-mo
pick.maintained: active; owned by Databricks since May 2025

alts.name: Supabase Free
alts.why: Best all-in-one if you want BaaS; weaker free tier for many products
alts.free_limits: 500 MB DB, 50k MAU, 1 GB storage, 5 GB egress, 2 active projects, pauses after 1 week inactivity, NO backups; Pro $25/mo (daily backups 7 days)

alts.name: Prisma Postgres Free
alts.what: Managed Postgres from the Prisma team
alts.why: Alt if you use Prisma ORM; spend fixed at $0
alts.free_limits: 200k operations/mo, 2 GB storage, 50 DBs; Starter $10/mo (1M ops, 10 GB)

candidates.name: Neon
candidates.verdict: PICK: 100 projects, branching, commercial-OK ToS, no pausing deletion

candidates.name: Supabase
candidates.verdict: Alt: best BaaS bundle but 2 projects, 1-week pause, no free backups

candidates.name: Prisma Postgres
candidates.verdict: Alt: simple, but 200k ops/mo cap is tight for an API

candidates.name: Cloudflare D1
candidates.verdict: SQLite not Postgres; 5 GB, 5M rows read/day free; good for Worker-only side projects

candidates.name: Turso
candidates.verdict: libSQL/SQLite; 100 DBs, 5 GB, 500M reads/mo free; pick for per-tenant SQLite

candidates.name: Koyeb Postgres
candidates.verdict: Free 5h tier only, company being acquired

candidates.name: Self-host Postgres on Oracle VM
candidates.verdict: Free but you own backups/HA; fine for internal tools

decision: Neon fits a founder shipping many small products: 100 free projects, standard Postgres (no lock-in, pg_dump out anytime), and ToS without a non-commercial clause. Choose Supabase instead if you want auth+storage+realtime in one dashboard and accept the 2-project/pausing limits; pay Neon Launch when a project needs >1 GB or real point-in-time restore.
details: From Workers, connect via Neon serverless driver or Cloudflare Hyperdrive (Hyperdrive free-plan terms not verified).

verify.note: Every Neon Free number confirmed (100 projects, 100 CU-h/project, 1 GB/project 20 GB total, 5 GB egress, 10 branches, 6 h history, 5 min suspend; Launch $0.106/CU-h, $0.35/GB-mo; instant restore $0.20/GB-mo). Supabase and Prisma alts also confirmed.
